newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Strauss-Kahn promises EMU pact views late morning.
newsitem.headline: Strauss-Kahn promises EMU pact views late morning.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said he would give his views on the European Union's budget stability pact late on Monday morning during EU finance ministers' talks.
He had been asked what he planned to say to France's EU partners about the pact, and when he would make his views public.
"You will find out," he said, adding this would be "at the end of this morning."
France's new Socialist-led government has made no comment on the pact, which is meant to limit budget deficits after the launch of a single currency in 1999.
But the party questioned it during the election campaign and Prime Minister Lionel Jospin said before the left's surprise victory that he would not feel bound by the pact, agreed in Dublin last year.
